content_text_body:
People who have strong social and technical skills can more easily adapt to new roles and responsibilities. As a result, these companies can adapt more easily in a rapidly changing economy. The objective is to help your team build transferable skills so that they can quickly adapt to new responsibilities and roles as the company changes. 

### Build social skills

As more tasks are being automated, strong social skills are increasingly needed and valued. Building communication, empathy, and listening skills is key to maintaining a competitive workforce. 

Read our [Communication Do's and Don'ts](Glint_Manager_Communication_Dos_and_Donts "Communication Do's and Don'ts") to learn how to build communication skills.

### Build technical skills

Provide regular trainings to help your team become more tech savvy. Peer-to-peer learning is another great way to build social skills and technical skills simultaneously.
